Customers report that coupon codes typed at checkout sometimes do nothing: an order of three $10.00 notebooks shipped to region "EU" with the coupon "SAVE10" shows an invoice total of $36.30, but it should be $32.67 (10% off, then EU tax). The same coupon works in some places and not in others.

Find the cause and fix it so every place a coupon code is accepted gets the discount. Do not change the existing tests.
